setup.method: All existing generic Fortran/include/makefile sources overlaid from immutable HEAD. Old case substitutes only generate_momenta_initial and generate_momenta_initial_inverse in genps_fks_radiation.f and boost_born_momenta_noevpr plus corresponding call in genps_fks.f. FSR routines otherwise identical. Each map/run independently adapts fresh grids with the same requested point budget and seed.
setup.diagnostic_note: Real plus numerical subtraction subset; not a physical separately complete cross section.
setup.confidence_method: For paired seed i define L_i=log(error_new_i^2/error_old_i^2). Report exp(mean(L)), median(exp(L)), and exp(mean(L)+/-1.96*sd(L)/sqrt(n)). This is an approximate normal interval, especially tentative for five seeds and heavy-tailed variance estimators. Aggregate ratio is sum(error_new^2)/sum(error_old^2). Reported point budgets are equal, so error-squared ratios equal error-squared-times-N ratios. Common seeds need not yield common physical points or identical random-stream consumption.
setup.variance_measure: Monte Carlo reported squared integration error times MINT reported production point count. Adaptive integration; not raw unweighted phase-space variance.

conclusion: No statistically resolved regression of the asymmetric map in the tested complete fixed-order calculations. Inclusive DY essentially equal; fiducial DY 20-seed geometric variance ratio approximately 1.06 with 95% normal interval containing unity; gg top-pair has noisy tails and does not favor symmetric globally. Evidence does not support changing the automatic default.
